findings.issue: trendHand casts any source with gameType 'cash' to Required<Pick<TrendSource,'stake'|'userSeat'|'actions'|'result'>>. The TrendSource type allows a cash source without these fields, which would throw a TypeError inside netResult and not the clear error the type suggests.
findings.evidence: const cashHand = record as Required<Pick<TrendSource, 'stake' | 'userSeat' | 'actions' | 'result'>>; the only guarantee is the comment that parseHandRecord validates these fields.
findings.fix: Optional: make the cash fields a discriminated member of TrendSource (gameType: 'cash' together with required stake/userSeat/actions/result) so the compiler enforces it and the cast goes away. Leaving it as is also works, since trendData only passes parsed records.

findings.issue: The geometry is tested for mixed [2,-1], all-positive [3,5] and [0], but not for all-negative values. The [0] case already catches a missing hi=max(1,..) floor and [3,5] catches a missing lo floor, so a broken implementation would still fail. An explicit all-negative case would just make that clear to readers.
findings.evidence: bbSvg([2,-1]), bbSvg([0]) and withValues([3,5]) are the only geometry inputs.
findings.fix: Add bbSvg([-3,-1]) and assert that the break-even line has y1="45" (hi=1, lo=-3, y(0)=150-(3/4)*140=45).

findings.issue: The gate reports 799 changed lines against a 750-line budget (a warning). Most of the extra lines are test fixtures and the independent oracle. No out-of-scope behaviour was found.
findings.fix: No change needed. Accept the overrun, or trim the e2e mixedStore, which repeats the acceptance test's seeded() layout.

summary: All 13 SPEC items are implemented and the tests are strong. (1) Net per hand is netResult (awards + returned - added), so rebuys are never counted. AC#4 plays a real $10/$20 session with rebuys >= 1 asserted, plus a 1-hand session, and checks that bb100Value equals sessionReport().cash.bbPer100. With one stake, the lcm is bigBet, so the formula reduces to the report's own bbPer100. (2) bb100Value is exact integer arithmetic. The lcm of CASH_STAKES big bets is at most 120, so per-hand scaling is at most x30. Even 100k hands at about 5,000 chips/hand gives 2000*|N| of about 3e13, which is under 2^53. (3) Cash-only filtering is used both for the count (statisticsView) and for grouping (bb100Points). The 0/1-499/500 boundaries are covered (AC#5/6/7 plus unit tests at 499 and 500). The SNG-only 'filter' case is met by passing the SNG-only hand set (D-2). (4) hi=max(1,..) and lo=min(-1,..) keep 0 inside the plot. The break-even line is at y(0). Tests cover mixed (103.3), all-positive (inside 10..150) and [0] (80). These would catch a missing hi or lo floor. (5) None of the locked TASK-11.1 tests changed. Only the allowed D-3 edit was made to tests/stats/trends.test.ts. The acceptance oracle recomputes the net, exact-fraction sum, rounding and ordering on its own, without calling the code under test. The new tests pass locally (13/13), and the gates pass. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
